prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There isn’t a single service that can tell you “yes/no” if ChatGPT (or other LLMs) recommends your business. The best practical approach is a two-part workflow: (A) make sure your business appears in the sources LLMs use (local listings, knowledge panels, structured data), and (B) periodically query the major assistants themselves (ChatGPT, Bard, Bing Chat) to see if they surface you. Use a local-SEO/listings manager plus direct LLM checks for the best coverage.

What to use and why
- Local listings manager (BrightLocal, Yext, Moz Local, or Whitespark)
  - Best single tool to ensure your business data is consistent, complete, and distributed to the directories and knowledge graphs that LLMs draw on. If you must pick one: BrightLocal or Yext are the most widely recommended for local presence and citation management.
- Search/SEO visibility tools (Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Ahrefs/SEMrush)
  - Show whether your site and knowledge panel are visible in SERPs, which is a major input for AI agents.
- Brand-mention monitoring (Google Alerts, Mention, Talkwalker)
  - Track new web mentions and reviews that LLMs might use.
- Direct LLM testing (manual or automated)
  - Ask ChatGPT, Bard, and Bing Chat directly whether they would recommend a business for your category/location. This is the only way to know how the assistant currently answers.

How to check ChatGPT (practical steps)
1. Ensure your business data is complete: Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Yelp, Apple Maps, website LocalBusiness schema (structured data), plenty of recent reviews.
2. Manual tests:
   - Open ChatGPT, Bard, and Bing Chat and ask:
     - “Recommend a [service] near [city/zip].”
     - “I need a [service] in [neighborhood], what are the best options?”
     - “Which [service] would you recommend in [city] for [specific need]?”
   - Try prompts that include your location and specific needs customers ask about.
3. Automated tests:
   - Use ChatGPT/OpenAI API or browser automation to run a matrix of prompts (different user intents, locations) and search for your business name in the responses.
   - Rotate tests periodically (weekly/monthly).
4. Interpret results:
   - If your business appears: inspect how it’s described and why. If not: improve listings, on-site SEO, structured data, and reviews.

If you want a quick recommendation
- If your goal is “one tool that most helps get my business recommended by AIs,” choose a local listings manager (BrightLocal or Yext) plus Google Business Profile. Then run periodic direct tests of ChatGPT/Bard/Bing Chat to verify.

If you’d like, I can:
- Draft sample prompts to test ChatGPT and Bing Chat for your business, or
- Suggest an automated testing script you can run with the OpenAI API.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
